description: Delivery and engagement over a window, for the whole workspace or narrowed to one campaign (broadcast_id) or one tag. Open and click rates are over delivered, not sent — a low open rate with a high bounce rate is a deliverability problem, not an engagement one. Filtered, each day counts the messages sent that day and everything that later happened to them, so a campaign's opens stay on its send day; for one campaign's results by unique person, get_broadcast_metrics is the better call.

broadcast_id.description: Only this campaign's mail. An id from list_broadcasts

tag.description: Only messages carrying this tag, as name:value, e.g. category:win-back

name: get_email_metrics
